=== Strategy ===

Tunare first spawns up in the tree house near {{Loc|Plane of Growth|(1524, -1633, 203)}}. When she is aggroed, she despawns and respawns out in the field at {{Loc|Plane of Growth|(1600,-235)}} where she is permarooted. The first instance has no FTE message, but the second instance does. 

Due to her knockback and root procs, it is very difficult for tanks to maintain aggro for the lengthy fight, if they can even survive her lethal flurries. When a tank is both knocked out of melee range and rooted, the raid leader must decide to either dispel the rooted tank, swap tanks, or accept some melee deaths until the main tank gets back in. Some guilds resort to using collision mechanics by stationing ogres behind the tank to prevent them from being knocked back, but this strategy is not completely reliable.

Effects Used:

* [[Power of the Forests]] - poison(0) based 800dd + knockback proc
* [[Vengeance of the Glades]] - unresistable 60 sec root, casted on her target every ~5 seconds
* Flurries for 960. Does not enrage.
